subject: Q2 Renewal / Roadmap touchpoint — scheduling and fallback plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Benton <alex.benton@clearwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q2 Renewal / Roadmap touchpoint — scheduling and fallback plan

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. As discussed, we’d like to schedule a 60-minute session to run through:
- high-level Q2 roadmap items relevant to ClearWave
- the expansion plan and proposed timeline
- a 20-minute product demo focused on API throughput and billing controls

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Mar 2, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 3, 15:00–16:00
- Thu Mar 4, 08:30–09:30

If those don’t work, share 2 slots that fit your leadership team — we’ll do our best to align. Also, if any procurement or security folks want to join, let me know and we’ll add a short compliance pre-read.

Agenda (high level):
1) 10m — Introductions & renewal objectives
2) 20m — Roadmap & timeline for dedicated capacity
3) 20m — Demo: latency/cost controls and rollout options
4) 10m — Next steps & mutual action plan

I’ve attached a draft roadmap deck for your review (q2-roadmap-deck-v2.pdf).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: q2-roadmap-deck-v2.pdf
From: Alex Benton <alex.benton@clearwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 Renewal / Roadmap touchpoint — scheduling and fallback plan

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear agenda and the deck. Quick constraints on our side:
- Our Head of Product (Lisa Chen) is only available mornings PT that week. She’s out Mar 2.
- Procurement wants to be looped but will only attend if there are line-item pricing questions.

Of your three options, Wed Mar 3 at 15:00 PT conflicts with an investor all-hands for two of our execs, so that rules it out. Thu Mar 4 at 08:30 PT should work for Lisa and me. Can you confirm? If not, we can do Fri Mar 5 09:00–10:00 PT as a fallback.

Also, a couple of asks before the call:
- Can you include a short note on data residency and retention policies?
- Any SOC 2 summary we can share with procurement would be helpful.

Thanks — I’ll cc Lisa once we lock time.

Best,
Alex
Director, Platform Strategy | ClearWave
alex.benton@clearwave.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Benton <alex.benton@clearwave.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 12:15:37 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 Renewal / Roadmap touchpoint — scheduling and fallback plan

Thanks Alex — that’s helpful context.

Thu Mar 4 at 08:30 PT works for our team — I’ll hold that as the preferred slot. If you prefer the Fri Mar 5 fallback we can switch.

Quick notes on your asks:
- Data residency/retention: included a one-page summary in the deck (slide 9) and I’ll paste a short blurb in the calendar invite.
- SOC 2: attaching our SOC 2 summary (SOC2-summary.pdf) for procurement to review. If they want the full report we can set up an NDA and provide the auditor letter.

I’ll send a tentative calendar invite to you and Lisa and copy procurement. If Lisa needs a morning PT time instead, let us know and we’ll offer Fri Mar 5 09:00.

If leadership can’t attend live, we’ll record and produce a 10–15 minute exec summary deck focused on decision points and cost impacts.

Looking forward —
Karthik

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, q2-roadmap-deck-v2.pdf

Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:05:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 Renewal / Roadmap touchpoint — scheduling and fallback plan

Hi Alex — looping in Rohan (our technical lead) and Marissa (renewals manager) to help with any in-call deep-dive or contract questions.

Rohan — can you plan to cover the demo environment and the proposed dedicated capacity sizing? If Lisa has tight morning availability on Mar 4, we can keep the session to 45 minutes: 25m roadmap + 15m demo + 5m next steps. We’ll record the demo and strip a short 10–15 minute exec summary for any leaders who can’t make it.

If procurement joins with line-item questions, Marissa can handle contract/redline logistics in real time.

Karthik — when you send the calendar invite, please:
- Add the one-page data retention blurb to the description
- Attach the SOC2-summary.pdf and the roadmap deck
- Mark the meeting as a recording with an option for exec summary follow-up

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
